steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thuy Sa, a water element shark, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: eyeing the food, fin up; (3) EAT: a big chomp with wide jaws; (4) EAT: chewing with puffed cheeks. Row 2: (5) EAT: licking its teeth with a big grin; (6) PLAY: crouching low on its tail; (7) PLAY: leaping up like a dolphin; (8) PLAY: arched high in the air. Row 3: (9) PLAY: spinning with a ring of water splash; (10) PLAY: splash landing with water drops; (11) PLAY: cheering with both fins up; (12) REFUSE food: clamping its mouth shut, fins crossed. Row 4: (13) PETTED: blushing, eyes closed, tail fin wagging; (14) WAVE hello: waving a fin; (15) SAD: fin drooping, teary; (16) ANGRY: teeth bared, dorsal fin raised.
